named_proteins.overlap_interpretation: the paper's symbols are human and the measured proteome is S. cerevisiae. A matching gene name does not establish orthology: some names are shared because the gene family is conserved and was named in yeast first, others collide by coincidence between independent nomenclatures. This script does not attempt to tell those apart -- no ortholog mapping was performed -- so the named protein set is recorded as context only and is never used as a yeast feature set or prior either way.
